data.name: Nawf
data.gender_notes: Nawf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nawf is derived from the Arabic word ‘an-Nawf’, which means ‘a gentle breeze’ or ‘a breeze that soothes’. It is also mentioned in the Quran (Surah Al-An'am, Verse 46) as a metaphor for a kind of mercy or compassion from Allah SWT. This name is believed to bring tranquility and calmness. The name Nawf carries the meaning “Gentle Breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawf usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nawf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawf total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
